claims.text:
14. ivf-probe-clusters

Target / packet: ai-ivf-probe-clusters · R3. Prerequisites: ai:ann-recall-speed, ai:k-means-clustering.

Nearest / distinct payoff: ann-recall-speed → ai-ann-recall-speed. An arbitrary inspection budget does not specify coarse partitioning; this probes centroid-selected lists and exhibits a real missed nearest point.

Finite primary model: Fixed valid coarse clusters A=[0,4] centroid 2, B=[6,7,8] centroid 7. Query 4.8 chooses nearest centroid B; nprobe 1 scans 3 points and returns 6 distance 1.2, while exact nearest 4 distance.8 is outside. nprobe 2 scans 5 and returns 4.

Countercase and mathematical boundary: Query 7 nprobe 1 returns exact 7. Coarse centroid choice is not itself nearest point selection; counts exclude the separately shown 2 centroid comparisons.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict recall@1 for nprobe 1 at 4.8; recall why nprobe 2 repairs this miss without guaranteeing every index budget trade off.

Required observable evidence: Retain coarse partition and list membership; no arbitrary assignments conflicting with nearest centroid of stored points.

Source obligation: Declared local finite model. Exact results require independent arithmetic reproduction; this construction supports no real-model performance or universal improvement claim. Method-source obligations remain as listed in the acquisition record below.
